game_title: Roll Call Enumerate – Canopy Walkway Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway, rope walkways in the canopy: the fairy gardener must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Roll Call Enumerate: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call.
theme: Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway: rope walkways in the canopy
core_gameplay_loop: In Canopy Walkway, repeat each round: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call. Each round, a new healing herbs challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the roll_call value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 290 points of healing herbs by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 290, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Roll Call Enumerate
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how roll_call changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bramble beasts in Canopy Walkway.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 290 within 31 seconds.
